gen_risks.description: Recurrent severe flood events can cause a sharp spike in non-performing loans (NPLs) and deplete capital adequacy across microfinance banks.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish and capitalize the Climate Risk Fund (CRF) to deploy post-disaster Contingent Liquidity Facility (CLF) loans for loan restructuring and recovery lending.
gen_risks.evidence: NPLs of MFBs in flood impacted areas surged by 25.7 percent... capital adequacy declined from 14.9 percent to 11.7 percent

gen_risks.description: Microfinance providers may disinvest or de-risk away from agricultural lending due to acute climate vulnerability.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide pre-disaster Innovative Agricultural Liquidity (IAL) bundled with agricultural technology company (ATC) advisory services to enhance farm yield and de-risk lending.
gen_risks.evidence: The share of agriculture in total lending of MFBs has declined from 34 percent in fiscal year (FY)19 to 28 percent in FY24.

gen_risks.description: Delays or omissions in requesting local currency budget allocations by GoP could block Category 2 disbursements.
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensure project funding allocations are explicitly requested and integrated into the GoP annual national budget planning process.
gen_risks.evidence: No withdrawals can take place under Category 2 until the Recipient has ensured... sufficient amount in its currency has been requested in its budget allocation.

gen_risks.description: Post-disaster mobility constraints and gender bias may restrict female borrowers' equitable access to recovery microfinance.
gen_risks.mitigation: Mandate a 55% beneficiary target for women backed by higher borrowing costs for non-compliant MFPs, loan officer training, and targeted financial literacy programs.
gen_risks.evidence: post-disaster settings further restrict women’s access... MFPs will be required to pay a higher borrowing cost... in instances there is deviation

gen_risks.description: Inadequate data or flawed catastrophe modeling could prevent accurate trigger calibration for contingent liquidity and insurance backstops.
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage specialized third-party flood risk modeling firms and credit rating agencies to provide independently verifiable data for parametric triggers.
gen_risks.evidence: Expansion of coverage to additional climate risks will require adequate risk modelling and data to design and implement the financial instruments

gen_risks.description: High costs or market fluctuations for parametric international reinsurance could erode CRF capital or make reinsurance coverage unsustainable.
gen_risks.mitigation: Perform annual financial modeling of CRF sustainability and utilize GSFF grant funds combined with CRF investment income to subsidize backstop premiums.
gen_risks.evidence: financial modelling on the sustainability of the CRF will be undertaken annually to inform this decision making.

gen_risks.description: Geographic clustering of agricultural loans may lead to cumulative environmental risks from increased pesticide and chemical fertilizer use.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce the project Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP) and apply SBP's Environmental and Social Management Systems to promote sustainable practices.
gen_risks.evidence: clustering of loans in geographical areas... where project interventions may increase use of fertilizers, pesticides and other chemicals.

gen_risks.description: Delays in executing and legally registering the Trust Deed between Ministry of Finance and SBP could delay project effectiveness.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prioritize legal execution and registration of the Trust Deed as an explicit legal condition precedent to project effectiveness.
gen_risks.evidence: Effectiveness 5.01(a): The Trust Deed... has been executed between the Recipient, through its Ministry of Finance and State Bank of Pakistan and registered

gen_risks.description: Microfinance market pivot towards short-term urban nano loans for consumption could undermine long-term productive micro-enterprise growth.
gen_risks.mitigation: Restrict CRF liquidity deployment strictly to productive climate-smart agricultural loans and structured post-disaster recovery credit.
gen_risks.evidence: Nano loans have grown by 342 percent... indicating an alarming pivot away from lending for productive purposes to consumption smoothing.

gen_risks.description: MFPs may lack organizational capacity or experience to effectively integrate agritech company (ATC) services into loan products.
gen_risks.mitigation: Execute the Agriculture Finance Innovation Challenge (AFIC) to pre-select capable ATCs and build operational capacity across participating MFPs.
gen_risks.evidence: MFPs that avail the IAL product will have to partner with at least one ATC selected under the AFIC

gen_risks.description: Complex pooling and multi-tier tracking of grant and loan accounts could create fiduciary and accounting errors.
gen_risks.mitigation: Maintain segregated child accounts within the pooled account, perform biannual internal audits, and subject financial statements to annual Auditor General audits.
gen_risks.evidence: The recipient will establish a pooled account – with segregated child accounts... SBP will maintain separate books of accounts

gen_risks.description: Sluggish administrative processing after a flood could delay deployment of contingent liquidity beyond the crucial 60-day window for borrower recovery.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish clear parametric triggers, pre-agreed data protocols, and streamlined Working Committee approval workflows in the Project Operating Manual (POM).
gen_risks.evidence: CRF liquidity which is deployed to originate loans within 60 days of qualifying floods (percentage)

gen_risks.description: Failure or delay in executing the Co-financing Agreement could block overall project effectiveness.
gen_risks.mitigation: Maintain active coordination between the Ministry of Finance, SBP, and co-financing grant partners to finalize agreements ahead of approval dates.
gen_risks.evidence: Effectiveness 5.01(c) The Co-financing Agreement has been executed and delivered and all conditions precedent to its effectiveness... have been fulfilled

gen_risks.description: Localized, severe flooding could severely impair specific MFP portfolios without triggering official government emergency declarations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Include a secondary portfolio-impact threshold trigger in the POM allowing individual affected MFPs to access CLF liquidity without formal district emergency declarations.
gen_risks.evidence: If the government does not declare an emergency... but a predetermined threshold of the portfolio of a particular MFP is impacted by the floods

gt_risks.description: Political and Governance risk is Substantial. The political context in Pakistan remains fluid. However, there has been significant decline in political uncertainty and associated policy instability in recent months, especially in the backdrop of the general elections. Given that a new government took the helm recently and the fact that policy priorities are still being defined, political risks, in particular in the context of the project, remain substantial.
gt_risks.mitigation: In the implementation stage, the risks will be mitigated through frequent monitoring and oversight.

gt_risks.description: Macroeconomic risk is High. While fiscal consolidation measures have supported short-term stabilization, macroeconomic risks remain high amid a high debt burden (72 percent of GDP), heavy financial sector exposure to government debt, large external financing needs, weak confidence, and little progress with structural reforms. Significant risks include potential worsening of external conditions, further natural disasters, and a slowdown or reversals in policy adjustment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Risks are partly mitigated by government commitment to implementation of reforms under the ongoing International Monetary Fund program, World Bank support to structural policy reforms in the fiscal and power sectors, strong government commitment to the reforms supported by the operation, and the availability of dedicated World Bank technical assistance to implement key reforms.
